targets.next: Audit done 03:38 UTC (AUDIT.md): E6 Halleck to Sherman and E12 Lincoln to Wolford were already in print (N1: OR I/32 pt 3 p.498; Basler 7:479). E4 Fox to Butler and E5 Meigs to Butler: no prior print or decipherment located in the sources logged (N3), and most of their words were never in cipher. Nothing here is a first decipherment. targets.note: Twenty 1864 entries read at grade H from cipher book mssEC 41; seventeen agree word for word with the Official Records, one with the printed Lincoln works, two (E4, E5) not found in the sources listed in AUDIT.md. Corpus question (AUDIT.md section 12): no one has mapped the ledger entries to cipher, key, plaintext and print; the project's decoding phase was never launched (paused Jan 2018, ended July 2019). A mechanical corpus pass over the volunteer transcriptions is possible and cheap, but it is an edition, not a solve.
